newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - July 15.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - July 15.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Tuesday, as reported by Kyodo news agency.
-- Japanese companies placing higher priority on overseas patents.
-- Japan Highway Public Corp to be allowed to issue its own bonds.
-- Education Ministry wants elementary schools to teach English after 2003.
-- Federation of Bankers' Associations of Japan helped with sale of fund-raising party tickets for politicians.
-- North Korea to allow Japanese women married to North Koreans to visit Japan soon.
